# Sparewise

> Sparewise is a free Windows 10 and 11 app that shows why the drive is full and helps you free space. It is a cache cleaner and storage analyzer with AI agent support (an MCP server for Claude, Codex, Cursor). No account, no telemetry. It explains every item in plain words, asks before every change, and what it removes goes to the Recycle Bin or is set aside for 14 days so it can be put back. Delete decisions are rule-based, never made by AI. Available in 30 languages.

- Get it: [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NHXHFH3CF1B) or [installer](https://github.com/sparewise/sparewise/releases/latest/download/Sparewise-win-Setup.exe)
- Source of releases: [GitHub](https://github.com/sparewise/sparewise)
- Who makes it: one independent developer. Free.

## What it finds
- App, browser and Windows caches that rebuild themselves; temporary files older than a week
- Windows Update leftovers, the hibernation file, old installers in Downloads, the Recycle Bin
- Games (Steam, Epic, Xbox) with size and last played; shader caches
- OneDrive files kept locally; iPhone and iPad backups
- For developers: Docker and WSL virtual disks, npm, pip, uv, NuGet, Gradle caches, node_modules copies, old Node/Java/Python versions
- Local AI models (Ollama, LM Studio, Hugging Face) with size and last use, and the same model stored twice
- Why the PC is slow: full drive, startup programs, pending restart, real memory shortage (no RAM booster tricks)

## Guides
- [C: drive full on Windows 11? Free up space, step by step](https://sparewise.app/c-drive-full-windows-11/): Why the C: drive fills up on Windows 11 and 10, what is safe to delete, what is not, and how to free space without losing files.
- [How to clear cache on Windows 11](https://sparewise.app/clear-cache-windows-11/): Which caches on Windows 11 are safe to clear, how to clear each one, and how much space it gives back.
- [Is it safe to delete the Temp folder?](https://sparewise.app/delete-temp-files-windows/): What the Windows Temp folder is, which temp files are safe to delete, and how to clear them without breaking open programs.
- [Windows Update says there is not enough space](https://sparewise.app/windows-update-not-enough-space/): What to clear when Windows Update fails for lack of space on the C: drive, safely and without deleting system files.
- [What is hiberfil.sys, and can you remove it?](https://sparewise.app/hiberfil-sys/): What the hiberfil.sys file is, why it is so big, and how to turn hibernation off to free that space.
- [Deleted files but got no space back?](https://sparewise.app/deleted-files-no-space/): Why deleting files on Windows does not always free disk space, and how to get the space back.
- [Why is my PC slow? An honest answer](https://sparewise.app/why-is-my-pc-slow/): The real reasons a Windows PC feels slow (full drive, startup programs, pending restart, memory) and the plain fix for each. No RAM booster tricks.
- [OneDrive is taking up space on my PC](https://sparewise.app/onedrive-taking-space/): How to stop OneDrive keeping a copy of every file on your PC with Files On-Demand, without losing any files.
- [Games are taking all my disk space](https://sparewise.app/steam-games-disk-space/): How much space Steam, Epic and Xbox games use, which game files are safe to clear (shader caches), and how to move or remove games properly.
- [The WinSxS folder is huge: can you shrink it?](https://sparewise.app/winsxs-folder-too-big/): What the WinSxS folder is, why Explorer shows it bigger than it really is, and the safe Windows command that shrinks it.
- [What is pagefile.sys?](https://sparewise.app/pagefile-sys/): What the pagefile.sys file is, why it is big, and how to resize or move it safely instead of deleting it.
- [Why is "System & reserved" so big?](https://sparewise.app/system-storage-windows-11/): What Windows 11 counts as System & reserved, which parts you can shrink with Windows' own settings, and which to leave alone.
- [Why is my AppData folder so big?](https://sparewise.app/appdata-folder-too-big/): What fills the hidden AppData folder on Windows, which parts are caches that usually rebuild by themselves, and which hold your settings and data.
- [C: drive full, but you cannot see why?](https://sparewise.app/c-drive-full-no-reason/): Space that File Explorer does not show: hidden system files, the hibernation file, Recycle Bin, Windows updates, Docker and WSL disks, and caches. How to find each.
- [Disk Cleanup or Storage Sense?](https://sparewise.app/disk-cleanup-vs-storage-sense/): What Windows' Disk Cleanup and Storage Sense each clear, how to run them, and what neither of them covers.
- [How to find large files on Windows 11](https://sparewise.app/find-large-files-windows-11/): Find the biggest files on your PC with File Explorer search or a drive map, and decide what to keep, move or remove.
- [How to find duplicate files on Windows](https://sparewise.app/find-duplicate-files-windows/): Find files saved twice on Windows, check that they really are identical, and keep the copy you need.
- [Can I delete the Windows.old folder?](https://sparewise.app/windows-old/): What Windows.old is, when it is safe to remove, and how to remove it with Windows Settings.
- [What are Delivery Optimization files?](https://sparewise.app/delivery-optimization-files/): What Windows Delivery Optimization files are, whether they are safe to delete, and how to clear and limit them.

## Privacy
- [Privacy](https://sparewise.app/privacy/): the app sends nothing; it checks GitHub for updates only.
